name: Three-position key selector
summary: A three-position key selector combines position selection with a key-operated mechanism.
description: A three-position key selector combines position selection with a key-operated mechanism. Stable positions, return behaviour and key-removal conditions are all required for a complete control description.
readingNotes: Do not assume that a removable key is allowed in every selected position.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Key operation adds access control to a selector; it does not change its electrical contact ratings.
